Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXI OF 2001
ZAKAT AND USHR (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE. 2001
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance 1980.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1,
15th May, 2001]
F. No.2(1)/2001-Pub. dated
15-5-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Zakat and Ushr (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 29A, Ordinance XVIII of 1980

ORDINANCE XXI OF 2001
ZAKAT AND USHR (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE. 2001
ORDINANCE XXI OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Zakat and Ushr Ordinance 1980.
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1,
15th May, 2001]
F. No.2(1)/2001-Pub. dated
15-5-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 29A, Ordinance XVIII of 1980.--In the Zakat
and Ushr Ordinance, 1980 (XVIII of 1980), in section 29A, for the words 'three
months' the words 'six months' shall be substituted and shall be deemed always
to have been so substituted.
